overviewParagraphs: Located a short drive inland from the royal beach resort town of Hua Hin, Springfield Royal Country Club is widely considered one of the finest and most challenging courses in the region. The original 18 holes (the Mountain and Lake nines) were designed by Jack Nicklaus, showcasing his signature style of rewarding accuracy and strategic shot placement.

True to a Nicklaus design, Springfield demands respect from the tee. The fairways are framed by mature, sweeping woodlands and a vast array of expansive bunkers. Water comes into play frequently, most notably on the iconic island green 18th hole, which requires a precise approach to finish the round.

A third nine (the Valley course), designed by Lee Schmidt, was added in 2005, expanding the facility to 27 holes. With its beautiful natural surroundings, exceptional maintenance, and rich pedigree, Springfield Royal is an essential stop on any Hua Hin golf itinerary.

curatorBriefHtml: Springfield Royal Country Club (opened 1993 by Jack Nicklaus, expanded with a third 9-hole loop by Lee Schmidt in 2005) is Hua Hin’s timeless 27-hole Golden Bear championship classic. Stretching 7,063 yards across the original A (Mountain) and B (Lake) nines (Par 72), Springfield Royal demands classic Nicklaus precision: wide tee corridors that tighten near water-guarded landing zones, gleaming bunkers, and elevated greens that reward disciplined iron play.

Having played Springfield Royal personally, it remains the essential third pillar of any Hua Hin golf week — offering mature tropical parkland maturity and classic strategic par 5s (like the split-fairway water-guarded 18th) that contrast cleanly with modern canyon golf at Black Mountain and hillside views at Pineapple Valley.
Located 25 minutes north of Hua Hin town, Springfield Royal is featured on our Bangkok & Hua Hin Fairways and Royal Siam Circuit alongside Black Mountain and Pineapple Valley.

scorecard.verdict: A timeless Jack Nicklaus 27-hole design featuring cavernous bunkers, manicured mounding, and difficult water-guarded approaches. A pillar of royal Hua Hin's golfing legacy.

faqs.q: Which two 9-hole loops should we book at Springfield Royal Country Club?
faqs.a: Request Jack Nicklaus’s original A (Mountain) and B (Lake) nines for the classic championship 18-hole routing, featuring the iconic island-style 18th finishing hole.

faqs.q: How far is Springfield Royal from Hua Hin hotels?
faqs.a: Roughly 25 to 30 minutes northwest of central Hua Hin and Cha-Am beachfront resorts by private touring vehicle.

faqs.q: Is Springfield Royal playable for mid-handicappers?
faqs.a: Yes — Nicklaus provided five tee sets on every hole, so choosing the White or Blue tees makes the forced carries manageable while keeping his classic strategic angles intact.

faqs.q: When is the best season to play Springfield Royal?
faqs.a: November through April is peak dry season in Hua Hin, with low rainfall keeping Springfield Royal comfortably playable throughout most of the year.
